name: Nijou Ranmaru
source:
He can be blunt or foul-mouthed with a prickly attitude, but he can't help but show his sweet side in front of you, the manager—a classic "Tsundere" character.

In the "Romance Route Expansion," his tsundere levels are at full throttle, perhaps even breaking the limit!?

Please fully enjoy Ranmaru's innocent charm!

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/4067070?emclan=103582791475364566&emgid=76131418419234205]Steam[/url]]
